headline: Why Are Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Shares Soaring Today
summary: Shares of medical technology company Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) jumped 5.3% in the afternoon session after the company announced a collaboration with Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders to raise patient awareness of its da Vinci robotic-assisted surgery systems. The partnership aims to increase understanding of different surgical options available to patients. Sanders, a well-known sports figure, will participate in the campaign to encourage informed conversations between patients and their doctor
